Jev is a new AI model built for fast decisions rather than generating text. In this tutorial, I explain how it differs from an LLM, show how to get started with its API, and build three examples: a voice-controlled browser, a memory retrieval prototype, and a YouTube topic scoring tool. You'll see what each prototype does and where Jev still needs an LLM or ordinary code around it.

Explore Jev: https://typesafe.ai/
